name: The Filling Station Cafe
tagline: Famous outdoor patio breakfasts in a repurposed 1930s historic gas station
description: One of the most charming morning destinations in Southern California. Converted from an authentic 1930s service station with vintage gas pumps standing guard, The Filling Station serves legendary stacks of lemon blueberry pancakes, eggs benedicts with silky hollandaise, and hearty scrambles on its expansive shaded brick patio.
historicNote: Constructed in 1932 as a Texaco filling station, preserving the roadside Spanish Mission tile roof, pump island, and mechanic bay doors.
